evidence: During a keyboard-only pass, interactive navigation controls should be checked for complete Tab access and usable Enter/Space activation. Record the affected control and attach a screenshot.
user_impact: Keyboard-only users may be unable to reach or operate important navigation options.
recommended_fix: Ensure every interactive navigation control is a native button/link, is reachable with Tab, and has a logical focus order and keyboard activation.

evidence: Check each form input for a persistent, programmatically associated label. Capture any input that relies only on placeholder text or an unlabeled icon.
user_impact: Screen-reader and cognitive users may not understand what information a form field requires.
recommended_fix: Add a visible <label> associated with every input and provide concise instructions or error guidance where needed.

evidence: Inspect meaningful images for useful alternative text and decorative images for appropriate empty alt attributes. Capture examples where an image conveys information without an equivalent text alternative.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may miss information conveyed only through images.
recommended_fix: Provide concise descriptive alt text for informative images; use alt="" for purely decorative images.

evidence: Navigate the page using Tab and Shift+Tab and check whether the currently focused link, button, or input has a clearly visible focus indicator.
user_impact: Keyboard users can lose track of their current position and may activate the wrong control.
recommended_fix: Provide a strong, consistently visible :focus/:focus-visible indicator with sufficient contrast and do not remove the browser focus outline without a replacement.

evidence: Run the target page through Lighthouse and/or a contrast checker and record any text or UI elements that fail the applicable contrast requirement. Attach the Lighthouse/contrast screenshot.
user_impact: Users with low vision or color-vision differences may have difficulty reading text or identifying controls.
recommended_fix: Adjust foreground/background colors to meet WCAG contrast requirements while preserving the intended visual design.
